info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Alkaline Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Alkaline Notebook Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed records for alkaline notebooks in the catalog. It enables businesses to efficiently manage product specifications and enhance inventory visibility. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce platforms looking to update or add new notebook details swiftly. Embracing this API supports streamlined catalog operations and improved customer experience through accurate product information.

post.summary: Create a new detail for an alkaline notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for an alkaline notebook. It requires the relevant data to be included in the request body and will return the details of the created entry upon success.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the alkaline notebook. It requires a JSON object that conforms to the specified schema, which includes essential information related to the notebook.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested notebook details.

CreateCatalogAlkalineNotebookDetailReque.title: Alkaline Notebook Order Request

alkaline_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier of the alkaline notebook being ordered.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person making the request for the order.

quantity.description: The quantity of alkaline notebooks to order.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the order is a priority (true) or not (false).

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the alkaline notebook.

CreateCatalogAlkalineNotebookDetailReque.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a new order of alkaline notebooks.
